dataset.name: La Réunion rooftop PV electrical production and shading dataset

experimental_system.description: Electrical production file dt2; AC grid-injected power Pg in W; held-out bins are documented healthy labels.

reference_system.description: Electrical production file dt3; nonidentical comparison line; AC grid-injected power Pg in W.

label_provenance.method: Fault labels identify healthy placebo bins and confirm there are no evaluable post-training shading episodes in the held-out test period; labels are never predictors.
label_provenance.label: Held-out healthy placebo; final-test labelled shading episode count=0.

energy_deficit.calculation: Held-out healthy placebo diagnostic only; no post-training labelled shading episode is estimable. This positive residual-energy integral is not a shading estimate. Trapezoidal positive prediction-minus-observation residual over adjacent held-out healthy daylight five-minute-bin means; this is a placebo false-shortfall diagnostic.

deficit_fraction.calculation: Placebo positive residual energy divided by expected energy over the same eligible healthy intervals; not an experimental shading deficit fraction.

coverage.calculation: Valid adjacent held-out healthy daylight five-minute interval seconds divided by available adjacent candidate interval seconds.

calibration_error.statistic: held-out healthy nMAE = MAE / mean observed target AC power

baseline_comparison.evaluation_population: chronological held-out healthy daylight five-minute bins

simple_baseline.name: capacity ratio from literal Table 1 module ratings (2.10 / 2.04 kWp); source capacity mapping discrepancy is documented

baseline_comparison.calculation: Both MAEs use the same held-out healthy bins; validation healthy data select the model. This comparison evaluates healthy prediction only.

uncertainty.method: No interval estimated for the experimental shading effect because no eligible post-training shading episodes are available. The reported integral is a descriptive placebo diagnostic.

independent_blocks.unit: no independent experimental episode available for a shading-effect interval

uncertainty.not_estimated_reason: There are zero evaluable post-training shading episodes; healthy placebo blocks are not substituted for experimental episodes.
limitations: This artifact reports held-out healthy placebo residuals, not an experimental shading shortfall.
No episode-level uncertainty interval for shading can be estimated because eligible post-training events are absent.
Healthy hourly placebo blocks can be serially dependent.

quality_checks.name: source_checksums
quality_checks.detail: Verified pinned-record MD5 and byte size for 4 downloaded source file(s).

quality_checks.name: exact_inverter_timestamp_alignment
quality_checks.detail: Exact timestamp intersection covered 100.000% of the smaller unique electrical stream; no nearest-neighbor interpolation was used.

quality_checks.name: heldout_healthy_calibration
quality_checks.detail: Held-out healthy model coverage=100.000%; nMAE=0.0141825; MAE=11.5098 W; signed bias=-5.16053 W.

quality_checks.name: reference_stability_screen
quality_checks.detail: Across healthy daylight bins, monthly medians of the capacity-normalized target/reference ratio; stable when relative max-minus-min range is at most 15%. This is a screening rule, not proof of reference-system health. Result: stable_by_predeclared_screen; monthly relative range=0.011307784356176853.

quality_checks.name: experimental_shading_coverage
quality_checks.detail: No evaluable post-training labelled shading episodes; final held-out test episode count=0. The placebo integral is not a shading-effect estimate.

quality_checks.name: noncausal_interpretation
quality_checks.detail: The healthy placebo diagnostic is a measured model residual; it does not identify physical cause or recoverable commercial energy.

reasons: No evaluable post-training labelled shading episode is present; 23 grouped episode(s) were excluded before the frozen evaluation window.
Post-training validation-period episodes, when present, do not establish held-out shading performance.

limitations: No post-training documented shading episode is estimable in this dataset split; the artifact contains held-out healthy placebo diagnostics only.
The positive placebo residual integral is not a shading shortfall, counterfactual repair yield, or verified commercial energy recovery.
The dataset is a La Réunion experimental installation; no Indian-site performance is inferred.
The two inverter lines are nonidentical; source capacity prose and module-table arithmetic do not reconcile exactly.
A deviation from a healthy-period reference does not establish physical cause.

findings.detail: {"status":"evaluated","synthetic":true,"method":"Deterministic-seed simulation deleting six consecutive observed 5-minute held-out healthy bins only where timestamps are exactly 300 seconds apart; the capacity-normalized baseline and frozen selected model are rescored on identical retained bins without refitting.","findings":[{"synthetic_missing_fraction_requested":0.1,"repeats":20,"mean_retained_coverage":0.8995937806415464,"complete_capacity_baseline_mae_w":56.70966181677241,"mean_capacity_baseline_mae_w":56.513297848115954,"capacity_baseline_change_from_complete_mae_w":-0.19636396865645622,"complete_selected_model_mae_w":11.509810302242265,"mean_selected_model_mae_w":11.555546882331319,"selected_model_change_from_complete_mae_w":0.0457365800890539},{"synthetic_missing_fraction_requested":0.25,"repeats":20,"mean_retained_coverage":0.7496007844235887,"complete_capacity_baseline_mae_w":56.70966181677241,"mean_capacity_baseline_mae_w":56.07138664308185,"capacity_baseline_change_from_complete_mae_w":-0.638275173690559,"complete_selected_model_mae_w":11.509810302242265,"mean_selected_model_mae_w":11.611635216547564,"selected_model_change_from_complete_mae_w":0.10182491430529872}],"note":"This sensitivity experiment is synthetic and does not represent the measured missingness process."}
